purpose: Make the aggregation of the 200 fixed outer realizations explicit before any global colour outcome is available.

outer_realization.field_intensity: realization colour numerator / realization geographic opportunity

primary_consensus.cellwise_rule: sum the colour numerators over outer realizations in which the cell is evaluable, divided by the sum of geographic opportunity over those same evaluable realizations
primary_consensus.equivalent_description: opportunity-weighted mean of realization-specific field intensity conditional on evaluability
primary_consensus.missing_support: a non-evaluable realization-cell contributes neither numerator nor denominator and is never recoded as zero
primary_consensus.aggregate_opportunity: sum of realization opportunity over evaluable realizations
primary_consensus.primary_G1_statistic: aggregate-opportunity-weighted variance of the consensus field over cells with positive aggregate opportunity

observed_stability_products.odd_even_consensus: apply the identical aggregate-numerator / aggregate-opportunity rule separately to odd and even outer realizations

null_aggregation.primary_p_upper: (1 + number of null G1 statistics >= observed G1 statistic) / 1000

fixed_seeds.stable_species_seed_derivation: first 64 bits of SHA256(master_seed + ':' + canonical species label)
fixed_seeds.stable_null_species_seed_derivation: first 64 bits of SHA256(master_seed + ':' + permutation_index + ':' + canonical species label)

canonical_ordering.reason: make balanced schedules and stateless null permutations invariant to input row order

forbidden_post_outcome_changes: switching to an unweighted mean consensus because it is more favourable
regenerating schedule or null seeds after seeing G1
using independent null shuffles in each outer realization
choosing a favourable subset of outer realizations
